How we know

Telemetro (Sept 19, 2026) quotes the Alcaldía’s own post cancelling the Sept 20 edition for the Panama City Marathon and calls it the usual Sunday program; its July 16, 2026 post gives Sundays 6:00 to 11:00 am from the Paitilla bridge. No post yet for the next Sunday.

For visitors

Free. Bike school, bike rental at Punto 0 (across from Rali), parking by the Miramar courts and at the Cinta Costera south gate. Suspended on some race Sundays and holiday weekends. Early start because of the heat.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Pace isn’t posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you’re new when you arrive.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

About the Recreovía Cinta Costera group ride

Recreovía Cinta Costera is an open-streets program in Panama City, Panama: streets closed to cars and open to bikes. It runs every Sunday from 6:00 am local time.

Panama City’s Sunday morning car-free waterfront. The Cinta Costera closes to cars from Paitilla to the end of its section over the sea. Flat, early and done by 11.
